payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased using utterances with negative system responses.

claims.text: Confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased by leveraging utterances with negative system responses, specifically when these domains are predicted with the highest confidence.
The approach formulates a loss function that demotes the confidences of the highest-ranked negative ground-truth domains to mitigate incorrect predictions.
This method helps to reduce confirmation bias and improve model training by discouraging incorrect predictions based on negative responses.
